description: A sophisticated living room with smooth plaster walls in a warm greige tone flanked by two arched openings — one on the left revealing a black-framed glass door passage and one on the right opening to an adjacent space. The focal wall between the arches is dominated by a large-format canvas with a terracotta-orange ground and a pattern of white cranes in flight, hung in a thin black float frame. Below it, a low dark walnut credenza provides console storage. In front of the credenza stands a round-shouldered cream ceramic vase holding a generous arrangement of olive branches and mixed greenery. Flanking the painting at mid-wall height, warm glowing orbs of soft light emanate from two symmetric positions, their gentle illumination gilding the plaster wall and warming the artwork's terracotta tones. The main seating is a wide cream linen sofa with loose back cushions in oatmeal linen and one deep espresso velvet accent pillow. A rectangular low coffee table with a white marble top and thin black iron legs sits centered in front of the sofa. The coffee table holds a stack of two hardcover books, a matte black sculptural bowl, an amber glass vase with dried blooms, and a small dark ceramic figurine. A cream-toned area rug with a faint vintage pattern grounds the seating group. To the far right, against the wall, a slim black iron console table supports a large dark ceramic vessel holding a sculptural tree branch. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered symmetrical composition looking straight at the sofa and accent wall, capturing both arches equally at frame edges. Mood is serene and editorial.
